text:
jen: green cluster is warmed and healthy, ready for phased fanout. planning a microflood pattern to avoid p95 spikes. starting at 02:30PT unless there are objections.
kai: acked. i'll watch p95, error rate, and KV cache hit during fanout.
mike: can we do a dry probe first (0.5% traffic -> green) for 10m? then 5%, 20%, 50. standard backoff if p95 > 150ms or 5xx > 0.5%
sara: agreed. also add a quick canary that hits the long-context endpoints. those are the riskiest.
jen: deploy-bot will handle weight shifts. i'll post rollback thresholds here and runbooks.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: router-service v3.2.0 -> green cluster. steps: dry-probe 0.5% (10m) -> 5% (5m) -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (gradual). Operator: @kai.
ops-bot: preflight checks passed: all nodes ready, KV cache primed, no outstanding alerts in last 1h.
mike: quick sanity check command for everyone: `curl -sS https://green-router.internal/_health | jq .status` should be OK.
kai: running prometheus queries during probe: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="router",code!~"5.."}[1m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="router"}[5m])) by (le))`
sara: adding long-context probe: `POST /v1/generate` with prompt length ~1200 toks, expect <= 300ms tail increase.
jen: rollback criteria (immediate): any sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m, or p95 > 250ms for 5m, or KV miss spike + cache warm failure. If triggered, rollback to blue and re-open incident channel.
mike: will set alert windows and tie to deploy-bot auto-rollback. please ensure the bot has rollback toggle.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback configured: thresholds pulled from /deploy/config/router/fanout.json. Can abort with `@deploy-bot abort` or force with `@deploy-bot force-commit`.
jen: timeline: T0 (02:30) start dry probe 0.5% for 10m. T0+10m evaluate -> proceed to 5% for 5m. ops on watch for p95 and 5xx.
kai: i'll be on pager and in this thread. mike and sara will monitor logs and eval traffic routing.
mike: if we see a regional spike, ops-bot should pin traffic back to blue for that region only. is cross-region pinning enabled?
sara: yes region-pin is enabled by default for this release. config snippet:```yaml
routing:
  regional_fallback: true
  pin_granularity: region
```
ops-bot: regional-pin toggle available: `ops-bot pin region=eu-west cluster=blue`
jen: final check: rolling release notes posted in #release-notes and change window approved. leaving quiet window from 02:15-03:45 PT.
mike: +1. starting log tails and latency dashboards.
kai: green. starting dry-probe now.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 (dry-probe) applied: green weight=0.5%. monitoring 10m. Logs: `deploy/1779991234/stage1`
sara: seeing a small increase in median latency for one pod, but p95 stable. watching. :eyes:
mike: 3m into probe: 5xx=0.02%, p95=140ms. looks healthy.
jen: proceed to 5% at T0+10m unless anyone aborts now.
kai: no abort. proceeding.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 applied: green weight=5%. monitoring 5m.
